parsed.explanation: No universal-exposure measure is documented: no facility, custody, border or document rule restricting trans visitors, no trans-specific criminal offence, and no violence record. Parent statutes do not extend, so no parent regime applies. Offsetting positives are thin: gender identity is not a protected ground, recognition is absent, and no trans complaint machinery exists (mostly resident gaps, but no documented remedy either). The heaviest visitor-facing signal is documented social hostility framed as moral threat — organized church protest against visible same-sex couples, which the dossier says could reach a trans visitor read that way — plus an official interference incident (2006, dated, single). Dated sexuality-law friction is secondary. Unanswered questions (documents, custody, wards) are lighter than known exposures. Net: elevated social friction with hostility present, no institutional exclusion or targeting documented.
